title: Performance & Scaling Strategies
description: Optimize application performance, implement caching strategies, use message queues for throughput, and scale horizontally and vertically.
longDescription: Master performance engineering: profiling and benchmarking, caching strategies (in-memory, distributed, CDN), message queues (RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus), database scaling (read replicas, sharding), and horizontal vs vertical scaling decisions.
whatYouLearn: Message queue patterns for async processing
